headline: Violent Clashes Shake Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the previous edition, intense combat has concentrated heavily across Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse, driving widespread base turnover and mounting casualties. Callahan's Passage accelerated with six strategic base transitions and over twenty-eight hundred combined casualties in the past two hours, centered on The Crumbling Passage and Scáth Passing. Weathered Expanse remains violently contested, logging five fresh base actions and more than forty-two hundred casualties in the two-hour window across Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Mooring County and Stlican Shelf maintained steady frontline movement with three base events apiece in the latest window, focused on The Wind Hills and Breaker Town. In Linn of Mercy, renewed fighting produced three base shifts around Rotdust alongside elevated casualties. Conversely, the intense island clashes previously seen in Fisherman's Row abruptly subsided over the last two hours, yielding negligible casualties and no new base movements, while Stema Landing and Nevish Line also quieted.
